9z.zh: 9z 快攻占 24%（51 个枪局），高于其他队伍的 13%；最常用爆弹是 A 点正门烟加小木屋顶火，5 次赢 2 次。CT 默认 A3 M1 B1 占 38% 枪局、胜率 78%，摸边多由 dgt 承担（4 次）。
9z.en: 9z hit fast 24% of the time vs 13% for others (51 gun rounds), and their signature execute is A with Mini smoke + Hut roof molotov (5 times, won 2). Their CT default A3 M1 B1 covers 38% of gun rounds at 78% wins, with dgt the usual lurker (4 hits).

astralis.zh: Astralis 拖后进攻仅占 5%，明显低于其他队伍的 27%（19 个枪局）。
astralis.en: Astralis went late on just 5% of their hits vs 27% for other teams (19 gun rounds).

aurora.zh: Aurora 有 58% 的进攻带摸边（24 个枪局），高于其他队伍的 33%，MAJ3R 是最常摸边的人（4 次）。CT 端 88% 的回合能及时回防，也高于其他队伍的 69%（34 个枪局）。
aurora.en: Aurora send a lurker on 58% of their hits vs 33% for other teams (24 gun rounds), usually MAJ3R (4 hits). Their CT side rotates in time in 88% of rounds vs 69% for others (34 gun rounds).

b8.zh: B8 有 55% 的进攻拖到后段（29 个枪局），远高于其他队伍的 25%，但先假打再转点只有 5%（22 个枪局）。CT 端开局前压仅 45%，低于其他队伍的 72%（31 个枪局）。
b8.en: B8 go late on 55% of hits vs 25% for other teams (29 gun rounds) but fake first only 5% of the time (22 gun rounds). Their CT early pushes are also rare, 45% vs 72% for others (31 gun rounds).

betboom.zh: BETBOOM 的分兵进点只占 52%，明显低于其他队伍的 72%（42 个枪局）。
betboom.en: BETBOOM split their hits on just 52% of gun rounds vs 72% for other teams (42 gun rounds).

furia.zh: FURIA 最常用的爆弹是 A 点正门烟加小木屋顶火（4 次，只赢 1 次），molodoy 是最常摸边的人（4 次）。CT 端开局前压高达 92%，远高于其他队伍的 70%（24 个枪局）。
furia.en: FURIA's go-to execute is A with Mini smoke + Hut roof molotov (4 times, won 1), and molodoy is the usual lurker (4 hits). They push early on CT in 92% of rounds vs 70% for others (24 gun rounds).

gamerlegion.zh: GamerLegion 的进攻 82% 打 A 点（17 个枪局），远高于其他队伍的 57%，B 点只有 18%；拖后进攻占 45%。CT 默认 A2 M1 B2（27% 的枪局）一局未赢（0%）。
gamerlegion.en: GamerLegion go A on 82% of their hits vs 57% for other teams (17 gun rounds), leaving B at just 18%. Their CT default A2 M1 B2 shows up in 27% of gun rounds and won 0%.

legacy.zh: Legacy 的招牌是 A 点正门烟加小木屋顶火，6 次赢 5 次；CT 默认 A2 M2 B1 占 27% 枪局、胜率 71%。堆点防守占 19%，其他队伍 8%（52 个枪局），摸边常由 saadzin 完成（5 次）。
legacy.en: Legacy's signature execute is A with Mini smoke + Hut roof molotov (6 times, won 5). Their CT default A2 M2 B1 covers 27% of gun rounds at 71% wins, they stack 19% vs 8% for others (52 gun rounds), and saadzin is the usual lurker (5 hits).

monte.zh: Monte 最常用的爆弹是 A 点正门烟加小木屋顶火，5 次赢 3 次。CT 端开局前压 50%，低于其他队伍的 72%（40 个枪局）。
monte.en: Monte's go-to execute is A with Mini smoke + Hut roof molotov (5 times, won 3). On CT they push early in only 50% of rounds vs 72% for other teams (40 gun rounds).

the-mongolz.zh: The MongolZ 的摸边多由 Techno4K 承担（5 次进攻时在另一侧或远离进攻点）。CT 默认 A2 M1 B2，占 27% 的枪局，胜率 57%。
the-mongolz.en: The MongolZ lean on Techno4K as their lurker (5 hits with him on the far side). Their CT default is A2 M1 B2, used in 27% of gun rounds for a 57% win rate.

vitality.zh: Vitality 的 CT 端开局前压比例高达 91%，远高于其他队伍的 70%（22 个枪局）。
vitality.en: Vitality push early on CT in 91% of rounds vs 70% for other teams (22 gun rounds).
